chunks: We favoured David with excellence, (and commanded): "O Jibal and Tair, glorify the greatness of God with him." And We made iron pliable for him.

key_terms.أَوِّبِي: Glorify (God) repeatedly or return to glorification
key_terms.الطَّيْرَ: Birds, also personified as glorifiers of God
key_terms.جِبَالُ: Mountains, personified as entities that glorify God
key_terms.فَضْلًا: Divine favor or excellence bestowed by God

ai.seo_question: What specific miracles and favors did God grant to Prophet David (Dawud) according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-Hadid* (softening of iron) as a sign of David’s mastery over creation for building armor, reflecting his dual role as a prophet and a just king. The personification of mountains and birds joining in glorification (*tasbih*) illustrates the cosmic harmony of creation under divine command, a theme frequently cited in Tafsir al-Mizan to highlight the spiritual elevation of the prophets.
